title: Handling a Difficult Client
paragraphs: Salah satu klien telah mengembangkan kebiasaan mengirim email marah karena keterlambatan kecil, dan Dina mendapati dirinya khawatir menghadapi setiap pesan yang datang dari alamat email tertentu itu setiap minggu.

Alih-alih merespons secara defensif, ia menjadwalkan panggilan telepon untuk membahas kekhawatirannya secara langsung, memilih untuk mendengarkan sepenuhnya sebelum menjelaskan alasan di balik keterlambatan terbaru yang memengaruhi proyeknya.
Selama panggilan itu, nada bicara klien perlahan melunak setelah ia menyadari Dina benar-benar terlibat dengan kekecewaannya alih-alih hanya memberi permintaan maaf yang tergolong umum lewat email.

Selama bulan-bulan berikutnya, hubungan kerja mereka terlihat membaik, dan Dina menyadari bahwa sebagian besar klien yang frustrasi hanya ingin merasa didengar, bukan segera menerima solusi yang sempurna.
answerKey: One client had developed a habit of sending angry emails over minor delays, and Dina found herself dreading every message that arrived from his particular email address each week. Rather than responding defensively, she scheduled a phone call to discuss his concerns directly, choosing to listen fully before explaining the reasons behind the recent delays affecting his project. During the call, the client's tone gradually softened once he realized Dina was genuinely engaging with his frustrations rather than simply offering scripted, generic apologies over email. Over the following months, their working relationship noticeably improved, and Dina realized that most frustrated clients simply wanted to feel heard rather than receiving perfect solutions immediately.
